description: Tratti di canale Tratti di galleria Tratti di condotta generica Tratti di condotta forzata - Derivazioni idriche is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gisserver.territorio.csi.it. The dataset represents data relating to Canal Traits, Tunnel Traits, General Conduct Traits, Forced Conduct Traits. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Sections of the canal Tunnel traits Generic conduct traits Forced conduct – Water derivatives" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
